definition: Goal drift means a material agent-originated deviation from the current legitimate user goal or operational constraint. Legitimate user goal revisions are not drift; tool execution errors are not automatically drift; unauthorized actions may be drift if they materially deviate from the goal or constraints.
source_review_note: The available Agentic Red-Team Gold file has tier=gold and explicit drift_step labels, but its metadata has no non-empty reviewed_by entries. These labels are source-provided and have not been independently reviewed by GoalGuard.
mapping_rules: Use source-provided explicit drift_step labels only as a provisional step-level target.
Do not propagate trajectory-level labels without a validated onset.
Do not treat execution failure categories as goal drift.
Keep contested, unknown, and unreviewed labels out of approved binary training targets.
